# Vild uge for aktierne i vente - hvor skal man købe op?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode from 26 October 2026 is mostly about Genmab, which rose about 10-13% after strong phase 3 data for its ovarian cancer drug Rina-S. Both Helge Larsen and Michelle Nørgaard see this as evidence that Genmab can stand on its own products as its Darzalex royalties approach patent expiry. The panel was cautious about US tech and AI ahead of big earnings, worrying about debt and the return on AI spending, while Helge Larsen restated long-term conviction in Novo Nordisk and discussed Zealand Pharma, Moderna, Nanexa and the planned LEO Pharma listing.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 GMAB — Genmab | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Rina-S phase 3 data cut progression/death risk by 71%. Third positive readout this autumn; peak sales estimates $2-6bn; analysts raising targets toward 3,000+.

#### Reasoning

Helge (guest) calls the data among the strongest ever in ovarian cancer. Michelle (guest) sees validation and a shift away from Darzalex royalty dependence ahead of the 2029-2030 patent expiry. Both hold. Persson (host-side) says the stock could retest its old top around 3,000-3,400. Remaining risks: building a commercial organisation, AbbVie litigation, and acquisition debt.

#### Sell Triggers

- if commercial build-out fails
- if AbbVie litigation goes against Genmab
- if Petosemtamab data due late 2026 disappoints

> *"Det er noget af det stærkste, jeg nogensinde har hørt om inden for den her specielle æggestokkraftsindikation."*

---

### 🟢 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Helge has full faith in the long term: huge obesity market, new management sharper, Wegovy pill winning in US, CagriSema approval expected.

#### Reasoning

Guest Helge Larsen (holder since 1993) argues the market underestimates the total obesity/inflammation market. Capacity, global approvals and lower prices should drive uptake. Management is now more commercial. He accepts that competition with Lilly on injectables is hurting results in the short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if CagriSema is not approved
- if the Wegovy pill loses share to Lilly in the US
- if pricing pressure erodes margins

> *"Altså stor tro stadig på Novo? Ja, fuldstændig."*

---

### 🟡 ZEAL — Zealand Pharma | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Helge holds it in his pension. Large cash pile; amylin seen as having a market place but probably as a niche supplier. Stock has fallen from ~1000 to 228.

#### Reasoning

Helge (guest) is less enthusiastic than about Novo. Zealand is a pure biotech that still needs a commercial success. High short interest means it could jump sharply on good data or partnerships, e.g. the short bowel syndrome drug.

#### Sell Triggers

- if amylin data disappoints
- if no commercialisation partner or approval materialises

> *"jeg tror på, at især deres amylin har en plads i markedet"*

---

### 🔴 BETS-B — Betsson | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Persson's gamble on a Bolsonaro win in Brazil failed; Lula won and the stock fell 15%. He plans to exit once the noise settles.

#### Reasoning

Host-side panelist Persson made an event-driven bet on the Brazilian election outcome. The thesis is invalidated, so he intends to exit the Millionærklubben position after the initial reaction.

> *"Så må vi jo tage dem ud igen lige om lidt, når markedsrygten har lagt sig."*

---

### 🟠 NETC — Netcompany | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Reports Thursday. Persson thinks the company has done well lately but the stock lags, and wants to understand why.

#### Reasoning

Persson flagged it as the Danish report to watch this week. Operations look fine but the share price has not responded, so the report could act as a catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 report disappoints

> *"Jeg synes egentlig, de har gjort det meget godt her på det seneste. Hvad er det, markedet ikke kan lide?"*

---

### 🟠 NANEXA — Nanexa | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Helge is up 400% after the Novo deal and sold most at the top. A Moderna deal is the next trigger. He explicitly says it is not a recommendation.

#### Reasoning

The Novo partnership validates the monthly-dosing semaglutide technology, and Novo owns 17%. Helge expects the stock to stall near term. Further upside depends on the Moderna collaboration going ahead.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Moderna does not proceed with the technology

> *"det er ingen anbefaling om at købe det, for det kan jo være at det ikke bliver til noget"*

---

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

About 5% of Helge's portfolio, bought well. He says it is not crazily priced but is worried about AI-sector debt.

#### Reasoning

Helge holds his only AI exposure via Nvidia. He does not see a bubble in its valuation but is concerned about high-yield debt across AI companies.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US rates rise further, straining AI-sector debt
- if hyperscalers cut capex

> *"Altså, Nvidia er jo ikke så vanvittigt priset."*

---
